description.en: Verb-function concept for expressing a condition, situation or state in which a subject is found or is presented in context.
description.es: Concepto de función verbal para expresar una condición, situación o estado en que se encuentra o se presenta un sujeto en contexto.
description.pt: Conceito de função verbal para expressar uma condição, situação ou estado em que o sujeito se encontra ou é apresentado no contexto.

metadata.notes: v0.2 distinguishes State from Quality by treating State as condition or situation in context. English BE may realize both State and Quality; Spanish and Portuguese frequently use ESTAR for contextual states and SER for identity or characteristic, but actual usage depends on lexical meaning, discourse and language-specific conventions.
